title: Blacklight
body_html:
Blacklight is the dark place inside, illuminated. Alone with my consciousness and devoid of the narratives about my self.

This is the crossroads between Untitled, DIS- collaboration and Reset collection.

title: Flesh
body_html:
Look at the body. Smell. Move. Stretch. Roll.

With Flesh, my aim was to make a scent that directed the attention to the body. The scent has a characteristic opening with industrial and cosmetic cues that suggest a sense of “new”. As it’s worn, that uncanny sense dissipates and it gets more and more familiar, eventually becoming imperceptible.

Try spraying this on a mirror and smelling it while looking at yourself for DIY immersive experience.

title: Yes, Please
body_html:
One of the dancers I collaborated with during the Reset project has described this perfume as

“I feel like I’m blooming internally.”

This is my favorite description and quoting someone else is too appropriate for Yes,Please.

For your first time, I highly recommend putting on a sweet song and overspraying the fragrance. Even if you are normally a skeptical jerk.

🖤

title: Purpl
body_html:
#vaporwave #dionysian #theiamania #absurd

These hashtags should help. If not, I don’t know what can. It’s the virtual reality dance club, it’s the creation of the myth, it’s the Babylonian explosion of language, it’s the party, it’s a clusterfuck of grapes or the tutorial room or something like that. It’s on the tip of my tongue. It’s Purpl.

title: Eaumer
body_html: The sea has a special place in my heart but I’ve often been disappointed with obnoxious “aquatic” fragrances that smell synthetic-clean. For my take on the theme, I avoided the usual aquatic notes and instead focused on what the air smelled like in my memory. The result was essentially an aromatic eau that conjures the seaside perfectly through illusion. Reminding me of a time when there was all the time in the world.

title: Ruh
body_html: Oriental is an aged idea about an exotic East that’s still in use as an olfactory theme. I wanted to update that theme and bring it closer to today. The process brought out what changes and what stays the same. A newly blooming Turkish rose. The smell of coffee. Attars, perfumes, incense, and spices still lingering in the now-air-conditioned souks.

title: Odoon
body_html: Being an homage, Odoon is a perfume of contemplation and I find words get in the way of it the most. It’s wood, uncluttered, unprettified and in full detail. Wood as I know it. Beautiful, functional, contemplative – all the things that wood can be.

title: Battaniye
body_html: Before being inspired for Battaniye, I had given up on trying to make a non-redundant amber. It was originally made for a friend who moved back to the California countryside after spending decades in chaotic Manhattan. I drew my inspiration from an evening in Trabzon: Watching a storm from the balcony, embraced by my old blanket. Watching this chaos from a protected place reduced it to a spectacle held at arms-length.

title: Zeybek
body_html: I composed Zeybek with a male character in mind even though it’s far from being a cologne “for men”. The namesake dance is a wonderful piece of the Aegean culture. It’s difficult to perform not because of the skill it requires but due to its expressive nature. The dancer is almost always intoxicated to avoid being self-conscious. The perfume oscillates between its floral, herbal and animal accords, proudly showcasing its complex nature.
